description:
Get the daily indexed-pages trend for a property: how many of its URLs Google had indexed on each day, from the pre-aggregated daily sitemap metrics (forward-filled and summed across the property's sitemaps). Each point is measured at that day's sitemap sweep, while get_indexation_summary is live, so the summary can run ahead of the latest point by inspections that finished after the sweep. Returns one series ("indexed") of {date, value} points, ready for a time-series chart. NOTE: only "indexed" is exposed — the daily metric's known-URL count is the plan-capped tracked-list size (not the coverage inventory), so a daily "not_indexed"/coverage-% trend cannot be reconstructed faithfully; use get_indexation_summary for the current not_indexed/% breakdown. Accepts a date range as presets (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_3_months, last_year) or absolute dates (from/to in Y-m-d). Also returns "points" (number of days with real data) and "insufficient_history" (true when too few points to chart meaningfully — the daily metrics accrue forward and cannot be backfilled, so skip rendering a near-empty trend). Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties. Returns feature_not_available when the property's plan does not include Indexation.

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Daily indexed vs not-indexed trend over the last 3 months.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","range":"last_3_months"}
```

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; pass either range or both from and to.

name: get_indexation_history
